answer.reason: The verses tell of Meremoth weighing the temple treasure and repairing parts of the wall, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: weighed the silver, the gold and the vessels in the house of God
clauses.quote: the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed

clauses.english: repaired two pieces of the wall
clauses.quote: next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah

doubts: NEH 3:4 and 3:21 call him son of Urijah, son of Koz, without saying he is a priest; I took him to be the same Meremoth as Uriah's son in EZR 8:33.
NEH 10:5 and NEH 12:3 only list the name Meremoth, and these may be other men of that name, so I left them out.
